name: Slyth
printedArtCredit: Vance Kovacs, Svirfneblin, Slyth, and Derro, p. 18.
sourceDistinctions: The player entry describes humanoid shapechangers without naming a formal subtype. It lists no racial Hit Dice.
Alternate Form has a 10-minute cap per class level and a cooldown equal to the time actually spent in form. The book gives no separate mechanism for reversion at the cap.
The loss of gear, natural and material armor, attacks, and component-dependent casting applies only in amorphous form. Ongoing force armor can still apply.
Wizards’ collected archive has no Underdark errata file. The official FAQ has no Slyth entry.
portraitForm: Plip Reedstone, an original Slyth Druid in normal form
